title: Each type at a holiday dinner
caption:
A holiday, a birthday, a reunion: every big family dinner has the same sixteen people.

One brought the dish they bring every year (perfect, every year). One started a debate about the best dish and argued both sides. One has packed takeaway boxes for all 40 guests. Swipe to find yourself.

Send this to whoever is hosting this year. They deserve to know.
